settings.title: On the TV
settings.text: TV game sticks with controllers. Best for the living room and playing with family.

settings.title: On the go
settings.text: Handheld consoles with a built-in screen. Best for travel and solo play.

settings.title: For two players
settings.text: Models that include two controllers in the box. Also a simple gift choice.

settings.title: Connect
settings.text: Plug the console into your TV's HDMI port and power it.

settings.title: Pair controllers
settings.text: Switch on the controllers that come in the box.

settings.title: Play
settings.text: Pick a game from the menu and start playing.

settings.question: Will it work with my TV?
settings.answer: TV consoles connect over HDMI. Check that your TV or monitor has a free HDMI port. Each product page lists what is in the box.

settings.question: Which games are included?
settings.answer: Each model lists its own preloaded library and supported systems on its product page. We do not claim modern PlayStation, Xbox or Nintendo titles.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: See our Shipping Policy page for current delivery times and charges.

settings.question: What if my console arrives damaged or faulty?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number from the Contact page and we will help. See our Returns and Warranty pages for details.
